# List of international presidential trips made by Lee Jae Myung

Lee Jae Myung, the 14th president of South Korea, has made 10 international trips to 13 countries during his presidency, which began on 4 June 2025.
Summary
The number of visits per country where President Lee traveled are:
* One visit to Canada, China, Egypt, India, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, South Africa, Turkey, United Arab Emirates and Vietnam.
* Two visits to Japan and the United States
